exposure: use of NeoBeat heart rate meter
cohort: All in-born neonates at two health facilities in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, between September 2022 and August 2023.
finding: The study successfully established an open cohort registry for newborn resuscitation in the DRC, collecting 85% of ILCOR's recommended core variables and serving as a model for resuscitation research in low-resource settings.
